title: Rational Ellipticity, Entropy, Euler Characteristic, and Formality
exact_target: Are almost nonnegatively curved manifolds rationally elliptic; do they admit Riemannian metrics with vanishing topological entropy; do nonnegatively curved manifolds have nonnegative Euler characteristic; and are positively curved manifolds formal?
